overpower.name: Overpower
overpower.description: Once per combat: spend a burst of Stamina to fight harder for a few turns.

underworld_strike.name: Underworld Strike
underworld_strike.description: Once per combat: an empowered strike that leaves the target vulnerable to your next hits.

buff_theft.name: Buff Theft
buff_theft.description: Once per combat: unsettle the target, weakening their next attacks.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: Once per combat: enter a bloodthirsty state, hitting much harder for a few turns.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.description: Once per combat: detonate stored momentum onto a single enemy.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.description: Once per combat: grant yourself a Shield equal to a portion of Max HP.

all_in.name: All In
all_in.description: Once per combat, for the rest of the fight: go all in - massively increased offense at the cost of your Defenses.
